summary: Frontend-only verification of admin console auth gate fix. All 5 scenarios PASS. Bug (static/empty admin UI for non-admin or expired token) is fixed: AdminConsole now probes /api/admin/dashboard on mount and gates the UI appropriately.

test_results.1_valid_admin_loads_console: PASS — /admin renders Dashboard with real data (Total Users 45, Total Orders 78, Revenue $303.64, Total Products 57). No admin-access-denied element present.
test_results.2_non_admin_sees_gate: PASS — Member token qa_member@example.com produced 403 on /api/admin/dashboard; UI shows data-testid='admin-access-denied' with 'Admin sign-in required' copy and 'Sign in again' (data-testid='admin-relogin-btn'). No empty console chrome/sidebar shown.
test_results.3_relogin_button: PASS — Clicking 'Sign in again' cleared soul_food_token from localStorage (null) and navigated to /auth.
test_results.4_invalid_token: PASS — Setting soul_food_token='expired.invalid.token' triggered 401 on probe and rendered the admin-access-denied gate.
test_results.5_regression_admin_orders: PASS — /admin/orders loads with 78 lifecycle-axes-<order> badges rendered (first: lifecycle-axes-QA-FUL-DIGITAL). Order Management UI intact.

critical_code_review_comments: Unrelated global console error observed on all pages: 'Failed to load products: TypeError: Failed to fetch' plus later 500s from /api/products in a global useEffect at bundle line ~120730 / index.js:131303. Not caused by this fix and does not block admin gate behavior, but worth investigating (likely a stale fetch race or a products endpoint hiccup during navigation).
